unpreventable_limitations: Same-UID DAC access: Processes running under azureuser (UID 1000) outside AGY tool execution share access to readable files.
Native Go hook fail-open: If hook process crashes with SIGKILL or exceeds timeout (>10s), native AGY runner logs a warning and proceeds.
Non-root filesystem immutability: chattr +i cannot be applied without CAP_LINUX_IMMUTABLE (exit code 1).
